I wrote `component.html` in this folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It is a 1280px `#component` with the "Approvals" heading, the "3 waiting for you" line and the three items. Each item is one card row with the title, requester, amount, and "Approve" and "Decline" buttons.

I followed `DESIGN.md` and inlined the tokens it uses from `tokens.css`. Only the light theme is included, and the fonts fall back to system-ui because the folder has no font files.

- **Buttons:** the screen's content has no top-right action, and the rules allow only one primary button per screen. So I made Approve a Secondary button (outlined) and Decline a Quiet one (no border). There is no primary button on the page.
- **Decline:** the rules say destructive actions use Secondary, but I treated Decline as an ordinary row action. If you'd rather have both as Secondary, change `btn--quiet` on the Decline buttons to `btn--secondary`.
